system.description:
Keepers of the ancient crafts and wisdom of witches and warlocks, druids, shamans and priests of the Old Gods. Organised into covens tied to the turning seasons.

Affiliation: Traditions
Affinity Spheres: Life; Forces
system.focus: Magick springs from blood, life and the living world – the power of the body, the seasons and the Old Gods. Verbena work through ordeal, sacrifice, herbcraft and the rites of the wheel of the year.
